method: Each listed image was opened and read through view_image. The real browser instrument separately checks canonical contact fields, viewport bounds, horizontal overflow, and whether the final answer line remains visible above ambient overlays.

findings.description: At all four pilot ZIPs, both phone themes now use viewport gutters below the actual Ask pill and a bounded scrolling panel. The ambient map legend no longer obscures answer text. Sidebar placement remains readable in both themes.

images.observation: Correct sourced service contact and route links visible; no contradictory empty-grounding message. Phone map and sidebar layouts reviewed separately.
